title: Promega ADP-Glo Kinase Assay
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs transfers of reagents for the Promega ADP-Glo Kinase Assay. It will transfer four different liquids into the test wells with pauses for centrifugation and incubations in between transfers. --- * [P20 single-channel GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Greiner Microplate 384 Wells](https://shop.gbo.com/en/usa/products/bioscience/covid-19/covid-19-non-binding-microplates/781904.html) --- Deck Setup * Greiner 384 Well Plate (Slot 1) * Opentrons 20uL Tips (Slot 2) * Opentrons 24 Tube Rack 1.5mL Tubes (Slot 4) Reagent Setup: Opentrons 24 Tube Rack 1.5mL Tubes (Slot 4): * Liquid A (A1) * Liquid B (B1) * Liquid C (C1) * Liquid D (D1)
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck hardware
steps.instruction: Place a Greiner 384‑well microplate in slot 1, an Opentrons 20 µL tip rack in slot 2, and an Opentrons 24‑tube rack (1.5 mL tubes) in slot 4 on the OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Load reagents into tube rack
steps.instruction: Add the four assay liquids to the 24‑tube rack: Liquid A in tube A1, Liquid B in tube B1, Liquid C in tube C1, and Liquid D in tube D1.

steps.title: Define wells and volumes
steps.instruction: In the protocol software, enter the number of test wells (samples) you will assay and set the desired volume of each of liquids A–D per well; wells are addressed sequentially across a row.

steps.title: Transfer reagents with pauses
steps.instruction: Using a P20 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, sequentially dispense the specified volumes of liquids A, B, C, and D into each test well, inserting pauses for any required centrifugation or incubation between each liquid transfer.

Dispense Liquid B into each well
Dispense Liquid C into each well
Dispense Liquid D into each well

steps.title: Prepare protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol script from the software and upload it into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Within the Opentrons App, run the calibration routine for the deck, tip rack, and P20 pipette using the provided calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the assay protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the automated transfers and pauses as defined.
